apps.localizedDescription:
NeoFreeBird-BHTwitter (tweak):

The ultimate way to tweak your Twitter/X experience.

This repository has been archived. All further development has been moved to the NeoFreeBird/app repository.

Supporting the Project:

I welcome all help on NeoFreeBird! Translations, bug fixes, and new features are all welcome. If you do see any issues with the app, feel free to open an issue and follow the templates provided. I also have a Ko-Fi linked in the repo if you wish to support me directly, but by no means is it required! NeoFreeBird will always be open-source and free to use.

Using your computer:

• Install Theos.
• Install cyan if you want sideload or TrollStore builds.
• Clone the NeoFreeBird-BHTwitter repository:.

• Make the build script executable:.

versions.localizedDescription:
New Features:

• Added option to see quote and retweet numbers (with an option for unrounded counts).
• Added an option to play a custom sound (under 7 seconds and with the AAC format) when a tweet is posted.

• NeoFreeBird now has (preliminary!) support for MacOS!
• Updated X to 12.31.1.

Fixes:

• Fixed Spaces not loading.
• Fixed all web views not loading (including Community Notes, reports, and web replying).
• Fixed the header switching back to black from dim on iPad.
• Fixed mute settings not loading.
• Fixed ads showing up in the Tiktok-like video feed.
• Fixed verified tweets not showing up in searches and edit histories when the “Hide verified tweets” option was on.
• dev: Fixed formatting on MacOS.
• Removed the “Edit Tweet” prompt showing up, this has been server-side for a while.
• Removed tweet source labels from the codebase, as X has removed it from all API calls.
• Fixed manual Grok Translate calls.
• Complete Spanish translation, added localized terminology file.
• Update Turkish localization and terminology.
• Updated Croatian ( HR ) translations.
• Revise Japanese localization strings for clarity.
• Improve Arabic localization.
• Update Korean localization.

Known Issues:

• The option to see quote and retweet numbers is not localized. Most likely will be fixed in the next version.

New Contributors:

• @polygonMicrosystems made their first contribution.
• @MarioBarisa made their first contribution.
• @ipapplus made their first contribution.
• @hooray804 made their first contribution.
